name: Soulknife

source.note: PHB-only subclass entered from knowledge; check against the book.

summary: Manifests psychic blades and uses psionic energy to bolster skills and talk mind to mind.

feature.name: Psionic Power
feature.summary: Psionic Energy Dice fuel Psi-Bolstered Knack (add a die to a failed skill check) and Psychic Whispers (telepathy).
feature.text: You have Psionic Energy Dice (see the table; one back on a Short Rest, all on a Long Rest). Psi-Bolstered Knack: when you fail an ability check using a skill or tool you're proficient with, roll a die and add it; the die is spent only if that makes the check succeed. Psychic Whispers: as a Magic action, link telepathically with up to PB creatures you can see for hours equal to a die roll; the first use each Long Rest is free, later uses spend a die.

feature.name: Psychic Blades
feature.summary: Manifest a 1d6 Psychic Finesse/Thrown (60/120) blade with Vex; a second 1d4 blade as a Bonus Action.
feature.text: When you take the Attack action or make an Opportunity Attack, you can manifest a Psychic Blade: a Simple Melee weapon you're proficient with that has Finesse and Thrown (60/120 ft), deals 1d6 Psychic damage plus your ability modifier, and has the Vex mastery. It vanishes after the attack. After attacking with it, you can make a Bonus Action attack with a second blade that deals 1d4 Psychic damage.

feature.name: Soul Blades
feature.summary: Homing Strikes (add a die to a missed blade attack) and Psychic Teleportation.

feature.name: Psychic Veil
feature.summary: Magic action: become Invisible for 1 hour; once per Long Rest or spend a die.

feature.name: Rend Mind
feature.summary: Sneak Attack with a Psychic Blade can Stun the target for 1 minute (Wis save).
